title: 第10章 林小姐是我们的人
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“三，三万呐……”老人缓缓眨了下有些浑浊的眼睛。

李建华连忙上前扶着老母亲，坐在床边，他吸了吸鼻子，咧着嘴笑：“妈，你不是一直想我成个家嘛，晶晶好不容易松口，要是我今天不买给她的话，她就立马跟别人跑了。”

“我……”老人看着自己的儿子，目光沉沉，里面似乎包含了很多很多情绪，但她没说话，只是默默收回了李建华攥着的手，起身，拿起老头子的遗像框，拆开后面，拿出了一张卡。

“这是我……”棺材本。

李建华没兴趣听她说话，一把将卡抽走，他脸上的笑容加深，看着老人的眼睛里满是兴奋，“密码多少？”

“900214。”

“我生日啊！”

李建华亲了一下卡，他吸了吸鼻子，又挠了下发痒的胳膊，再也不看身后的老人，满心满眼都是手中的卡，连句离别的话都没说，风风火火地开门走了。

窄小的房间，老人坐在桌子上，落寞地、发着呆地看着面前的鸡汤。

“人出来了。”

李建华双手插兜，嘴里哼着歌，步伐轻快地出了单元楼。

目光扫视着四周，看了眼坐在街边吃面的两人，又瞥了眼一旁扫地的清洁工。

李建华走到一个角落，看了眼时间，走到旁边一个煎饼果子摊，买了一个标准版的。

等煎饼的功夫，他接了一个电话。

“换地方了？定哪儿了？”

“真的假的，新的？”

“……当然要！给我留十袋……正在来的路上呢。”

挂断了电话，李建华催促道：“师傅，快点，赶时间呢。”

“诶，好，马上！”

老师傅将煎饼装袋递给了李建华。

他接过，顺便看了眼手机。

而后站在一辆摩托车旁边，几大口吃完了煎饼，随手将垃圾袋一丢，骑着摩托车就走了。

“人沿着华顺街去了。”

另一边，街边一个毫不起眼的小型KTV门口，蹲着一个抽烟的男人。

不一会儿，一个瘦高男人走了出来，笑容谄媚，“哥，人一会儿就到了。”

“呵……要不是条子盯得紧，这批货不会这么低价出的，你们算是走了好运。”

钱豹连连应着：“谢谢哥。”

“你没有告诉别人吧？”

"Three, thirty thousand..." The old man slowly blinked his somewhat cloudy eyes.

Li Jianhua hurriedly stepped forward to support his old mother and sat on the edge of the bed. He sniffed and grinned: "Mom, haven't you always wanted me to have a family? Jingjing finally let go. If I don't buy it for her today, she will run away with someone else immediately."

"I..." The old man looked at her son with a heavy gaze, which seemed to contain many emotions, but she did not speak. She just silently retracted Li Jianhua's hand, stood up, picked up the old man's portrait frame, opened the back, and took out a card.

"This is me..." Coffin Ben.

Li Jianhua was not interested in listening to her and took the card away. The smile on his face deepened and he looked at the old man's eyes full of excitement, "What's the password?"

"900214."

"It's my birthday!"

Li Jianhua kissed Ka, he sniffed, and scratched his itchy arm. He no longer looked at the old man behind him, his mind and eyes were full of Ka, and he opened the door and left in a hurry without saying a word of farewell.

In the small room, the old man sat on the table, looking at the chicken soup in front of him lonely and dazedly.

"People are coming out."

Li Jianhua put his hands in his pockets, hummed a song, and walked out of the unit building briskly.

He glanced around, glanced at the two people sitting on the street eating noodles, and then glanced at the cleaner sweeping the floor.

Li Jianhua walked to a corner, looked at the time, walked to a pancake and fruit stand nearby, and bought a standard version.

While waiting for the pancakes, he answered a phone call.

"Changed the place? Where did you decide?"

"Real or fake, new?"

"...Of course! Leave me ten bags...on the way here."

After hanging up the phone, Li Jianhua urged: "Master, hurry up, I'm in a hurry."

"Hey, okay, right away!"

The old chef bagged the pancakes and handed them to Li Jianhua.

He took it and looked at his phone.

Then he stood next to a motorcycle, ate the pancakes in several gulps, threw away the garbage bag, and left on the motorcycle.

"People went along Huashun Street."

On the other side, at the door of an inconspicuous small KTV on the street, a smoking man squatted.

After a while, a tall and thin man came out with a flattering smile, "Brother, we'll be here in a minute."

"Haha... If the policemen hadn't kept a close eye on them, this batch of goods wouldn't have been sold at such a low price. You guys are lucky."

Qian Bao responded repeatedly: "Thank you, brother."

"You didn't tell anyone, right?"
